title: Senior Software Engineer – Platform Engineering
jobDescription:
organization. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the cloud platform capabilities that empower our product engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate highly scalable applications on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work closely with software engineers to enhance deployment automation, cloud-native infrastructure, application reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving infrastructure-related engineering challenges while remaining embedded within a software engineering organization. What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark. Design, build, and maintain cloud-native application platforms on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes. Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (Oracle Kubernetes Engine
- OKE). Develop Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) solutions using Terraform and automation frameworks. Build deployment automation, reusable platform components, and self-service engineering capabilities. Improve deployment reliability through automated rollbacks, deployment validation, and release orchestration. Collaborate with software engineering teams to troubleshoot production issues and improve platform stability. Monitor application health, infrastructure performance, and availability using observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, and Open Telemetry. Implement cloud security best practices, secrets management, SSL certificate management, and access controls. Optimize cloud infrastructure utilization, scalability, availability, and operational costs. Automate operational tasks using Python, Node.js, Bash, or similar scripting languages. Support production releases, incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvements. Document platform architecture, deployment standards, operational runbooks, and engineering best practices. Contribute to engineering standards, cloud-native architecture, and platform modernization initiatives. Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters, preferably Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE). Strong experience with Docker and containerized application deployments. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, or similar automation platforms. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Strong Linux administration and shell scripting experience. Proficiency in Python or Node.js for automation, deployment tooling, and operational scripting. Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, Load Balancers, SSL/TLS, firewalls, and cloud networking. Experience working with Git and modern software development workflows. Experience troubleshooting distributed applications and production environments. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Helm Charts. Experience with Cloudflare, including CDN, DNS, WAF, Load Balancing, and Tunnel configurations. Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, and Open Telemetry. Experience implementing Git Ops practices using tools such as Argo CD. Familiarity with microservices and cloud-native application architecture. Experience with security scanning, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening. Knowledge of cloud cost optimization and resource utilization strategies. Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. Hands-on experience with Software Defined Networking (SDN) concepts. Experience with enterprise virtualization and container platforms such as Proxmox, OKD/Open Shift, or similar technologies. title: Tag Management Specialist
jobDescription:
reporting to the Marketing Technology Senior Manager and collaborating across marketing, engineering, and analytics teams. What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark. Architect and maintain scalable tagging frameworks across multiple digital properties, not one-off implementations. Write and maintain custom Java Script within Adobe Launch rules, including Adobe Analytics custom code (s-object, TL calls, custom events, e Vars, plugins). Implement, update, and troubleshoot Adobe Launch tags including rules, data elements, and extensions. Perform rigorous QA and validation of standard marketing pixels (Meta, Floodlights), custom pixels, and third-party scripts — both client-side and server-side. Develop and maintain robust data layers in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Ensure accurate integration between Adobe Launch and downstream platforms including Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and third-party ad vendors. Monitor tag performance and recommend optimizations to minimize site performance impact. Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all tagging implementations, naming conventions, and processes. Partner with marketing, engineering, and analytics stakeholders to gather requirements and execute tagging strategies. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential — this role requires translating technical tagging details for non-technical stakeholders and working effectively across teams. Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed. Experience Requirements: Adobe Launch: 3+ years minimum (hard requirement). Deep, hands-on implementation experience required. Java Script & Adobe Analytics Custom Code: 3+ years. Must be proficient in writing custom code within Adobe Launch rules, including Adobe Analytics s-object manipulation, TL() calls, custom events and e Vars, and plugin implementation. Third-Party Pixel & Script QA: 2+ years validating marketing pixels (e.g., Meta, Floodlights, custom/Io T ad pixels) and third-party scripts using browser dev tools, Charles Proxy, or equivalent. Ecommerce Tag Management: 1+ year minimum. Experience tracking ecommerce events (product views, cart, purchase) and working with ecommerce data layers is required. Technical Requirements: Adobe Launch (required): Expert-level. Rule architecture, data elements, custom code, extensions, publishing workflow. Java Script (required): Custom coding within Launch rules; Adobe Analytics s-object, TL() link tracking, plugin implementation, event-driven patterns. Adobe Analytics (required): Familiarity with AA implementation concepts — props, e Vars, events, processing rules, and custom code. Pixel & Script Validation (required): Proficiency with browser dev tools, network tab inspection, and QA tools (e.g., Charles Proxy, Omnibug, Adobe Debugger). Server-Side Tagging (highly desired): Experience with server-side tag implementations strongly preferred. HTML/CSS: Working proficiency required. Privacy Compliance: Some exposure to consent management and privacy implementation (e.g., One Trust, cookie compliance). Customer Data Platform (nice to have): Experience with CDP ingestion is a bonus, not required.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Adobe Launch or Adobe Analytics certification. Experience with Google Tag Manager or Tealium IQ (demonstrates platform breadth). Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira. Understanding of digital marketing campaign structures and attribution. Adobe Web SDK experience a plus. What We’re Looking For: The right candidate can open a page, fire up the network tab, identify a broken pixel, trace it back to a Launch rule condition, write a fix in custom code, and document it — all without being asked twice. You think in systems, not tickets. You care about naming conventions, clean data layers, and getting it right the first time. Why you’ll love us.
